speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: But, Mr Speaker, if you would allow me, for perspective, it is also useful to note the steady improvements in the workplace fatal injury rate in the last two decades.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: And 2018, we had an all-time low of 1.2, if you bring it down by 75%.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: So, we are seeing that overall, Singapore's workplace safety compares favourably with many developed countries.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: And our workplace fatality rate is the lowest in Asia and is comparable to countries like Denmark and Finland.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Improvements have also taken place against the backdrop of heavy reliance on foreign workers in sectors most prone to workplace fatalities, such as the construction, marine and process industries.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Much attention is put on helping newly arrived foreign workers to practise good WSH habits.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This is an ambitious goal reflecting our commitment to workers' safety.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: If these are not well-managed, these conditions can contribute to work accidents.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Prevention of workplace injuries goes hand in hand with efforts to promote workforce health.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This is so that fewer workers suffer from ill-health and even those with chronic diseases can continue to work safely and productively as long as they want.
